verdict.rationale: Zapier's help docs on troubleshooting Zap errors, including AI-generated troubleshooting instructions to review, indirectly suggest that failed runs can be inspected. Nothing in the evidence describes an execution log or history view, or any way to replay a failed run. Missing for 10: documented run history and execution-log inspection, re-running a failed execution, resuming from the failing step, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
